name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v1868: The live-state gate watched five files and not his session journal, which is how a test harness wrote 1729 rows into it unseen. Teaching it to watch turned it red within one run and it found two more writers: a button matrix that carefully took a private port and then handed the app his real environment, and the subscription-cap tests, which exist to cause refusals and journal every one of them into his live file while leaking a daily cap of one into every later test. Also his budget meter held a millisecond timestamp among seconds, and since both windows subtract, it sat in the future and never expired.
